# discovery

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/grafana/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/grafana/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Grafana-owned discovery profile and collection partition identifier.

`connectors_grafana.discovery` is one of connectors_grafana's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ObservationProfile`

`connectors_grafana.discovery.ObservationProfile` is one of `grafana-datasources`.

### `PartitionKind`

`connectors_grafana.discovery.PartitionKind` is one of `collection`.

### `RecognitionProvider`

`connectors_grafana.discovery.RecognitionProvider` is one of `prometheus`, `loki` and `alertmanager`.

Three of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_grafana.discovery.ObservationProfile`, `connectors_grafana.discovery.PartitionKind` and `connectors_grafana.discovery.RecognitionProvider`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
